text:
zoe: Noticed a drift from the nightly encryption inventory: ~12 DB snapshots in prod-region-eu show encrypted=false in our audit index. filing here before I dig deeper.

felix: What prefix/keys? could be replication or older agent behavior.

zoe: Prefix: prod-snapshots/db/2026-03-22/. Keys look like tenant13/* and tenant77/*. sizes ~2GB each.

tara: Any recent RBAC or KMS policy changes? ops pushed a batch of key-policy updates last night.

sec-bot: KMS ChangeEvent: key-policy-update by ops_kevin at 2026-03-22T00:45Z for arn:aws:kms:eu:key/zzzz-yyyy-qqqq.

felix: If key policy tightened who can use GrantCrypt, agents using ephemeral grants might have been denied. Check agent logs for kms:Encrypt errors.

zoe: Logs pulled from backup-wn-21: 
`2026-03-22T01:12:03Z WARN uploader.go: failed to apply SSE-KMS header: AccessDenied: not authorized to use key`

tara: That's consistent. But two oddities: 1) our uploader should abort on AccessDenied, 2) some older replicate jobs still set SSE=AES256 (SSE-S3) not SSE-KMS. maybe cross-region replication rewrote headers.

felix: Good catch. If replication role doesn't have kms:Encrypt, replication may copy object but not set SSE-KMS. Which replication config? cross-region-replica-rules-3 applies for tenant77.

zoe: Confirmed: replication logs show PutObject to dest with `x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256` for three keys. Source objects lacked SSE-KMS but had SSE-KMS on older runs; replication seems to be the step that lost the KMS header.

tara: So two simultaneous failures: uploader couldn't KMS encrypt (AccessDenied), then replication used SSE-S3 for the copy. Need to treat replicated objects as unencrypted w.r.t customer CMKs.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-0099. Severity: Medium. PagerDuty notified.

felix: Triage path: 1) enumerate all objects where Inventory.serverSideEncryption != aws:kms AND objectKey matches db snapshots. 2) identify replication jobs and source hosts. 3) check CloudTrail for kms:Encrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey calls around those times.

zoe: Running enumeration now. Will attach CSV to incident. ETA 12m.

infra: Ops note: I pushed a KMS policy tighten to block `kms:Encrypt` for all roles except `backup-role` at 00:45. But I see a race where new `backup-role-v2` wasn't attached to hosts yet. Oops.

tara: We should rollback that key policy change or explicitly add `backup-role-v2` to the allow list immediately. Which is safer? rollback quick or add role ARN?

infra: Rollback faster. I'll revert policy at 01:05. But we still need retroactive remediation for objects already copied with AES256.

felix: Revert done. Confirmed KMS policy back to previous state. Hosts now showing kms:Encrypt successes on subsequent runs.

zoe: Enumeration CSV attached to INC-20260322-0099: 12 keys across tenant13/77, 3 appear in cross-region replica bucket with SSE=AES256 (SSE-S3). No GetObject events detected in SIEM for those keys since upload.

tara: Containment: 1) quarantine replicated copies (move to quarantine-prefix with SSE-KMS), 2) add temporary bucket policy preventing reads from non-internal principals for those prefixes, 3) run SIEM query for any PutObject by replication role to see if extra copies exist.

felix: Remediation plan: copy replicated AES256 objects to new keys with --sse aws:kms (use the correct CMK), update inventory and metadata to point apps to the new keys, mark old copies for lifecycle-delete after retention period.

infra: I'll schedule a controlled copy job and throttle to avoid IO spike. We'll start with tenant13 small snapshots first.

comms: tagging in case we need customer outreach. please provide list of tenant ids and whether there is evidence of read access.

zoe: SIEM shows no reads; CloudTrail shows kms:Encrypt denied events at 01:11 then successful after rollback at 01:07 (a few hosts). This looks like a brief window.

tara: Postmortem AIs: - add deploy gating for KMS policy changes (ops) - require uploader to abort on KMS denies (devex) - monitor replication transforms that change SSE type (storage infra) - audit 180 days of db snapshot headers (sec)

felix: Also add an automated test: simulate KMS deny and assert uploader does not complete PutObject. Add metric encryption.upload_failures.kms_denied and an alert threshold >0.

zoe: Copy jobs started. will update incident with progress and final delete plan. thanks team.

infra: Good catch, team. keeping ticket open until quarantine complete.
